purpose: Project bounded observable BrainOS/ConvoOS execution state into chat and reuse FairyOS for deterministic operator selection without creating a second cognitive or effect authority.

ownership.ConvoOS: typed current conversation state contract pointer
ownership.FairyOS: operator identity, dispatch, expression and member-native basin semantics

reuse_law.dispatch: ChatOS MUST call or import the canonical GaiaOS FairyOS resolver; it MUST NOT carry an independent copy of member signal rules.
reuse_law.memory: ChatOS MUST consume bounded current ConvoOS consequence when material; it MUST NOT become conversation-history authority.
reuse_law.brain: ChatOS MUST NOT become a BrainOS component or replace the BrainOS compiler.
reuse_law.effects: ChatOS presentation authority is NONE; domain effects stay owner-native and Naomi-settled.

keep_when: prevents Naomi from reconstructing current state
compress_when: forces all six operators to speak without materiality
adds personality without changing or clarifying work
